data_governance.confidentiality_statement: All operational customer records, order records, and policy documents in this repository are strictly synthetic or derived from public standard e-commerce retail policies. No real personal records, private customer data, or proprietary client data is ingested.
data_governance.compliance: Compliant with assignment safety rules and GDPR synthetic data generation guidelines.

datasets.name: E-Commerce Customer Service Standard Operating Policies
datasets.source_lineage: Modeled after standard public retail e-commerce customer service policies (Amazon, BestBuy, Target standard return/shipping policies). Formatted and curated synthetically for RAG evaluation.

datasets.name: Customer Support FAQ & Operational Knowledge Catalog
datasets.source_lineage: Synthetically generated standard retail FAQ pairs covering exceptions, lost packages, cancellation boundaries, and defect compensation.

datasets.name: ERP Operational Customer, Product, and Order Records
datasets.source_lineage: Programmatically generated via mcp-server/src/db/seed.ts using faker-style realistic retail data schemas matching Microsoft Dynamics 365 / SAP Sales Orders schema conventions.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Customer profiles, contact info, shipping addresses

tables.name: products
tables.description: Catalog items across 6 categories with stock and warranty months

tables.name: orders
tables.description: Transactional order records with tracking numbers and statuses

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: Line items linked to orders and catalog products

ingestion_pipeline.chunking_strategy: Semantic paragraph windowing with overlap (500 chars window, 50 chars overlap) for Markdown; discrete item mapping for JSON FAQs.
ingestion_pipeline.repeatability: Idempotent collection recreation with hash tracking and metadata retention (source, format, category, chunk_id).
